scripts.build: node scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label build -- node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.test: node scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label unit-tests -- node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage
scripts.test:browser: node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label browser-tests -- node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/browser/browser-test.ts
scripts.test:devices: node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label device-tests -- node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/browser/test-devices.ts
scripts.check:adoption: node scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label adoption -- node scripts/checks/check-adoption.ts
scripts.check:push: node scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label verification -- node scripts/checks/run-local-checks.ts
scripts.browser:doctor: node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label gpu-discovery -- node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/browser/browser-doctor.ts
scripts.browser:cli: node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/workflow/workload.ts run --label browser-cli -- node --import ./scripts/browser/playwright-browsers-env.ts scripts/browser/browser-test-cli.ts
